Natural warm morning daylight from upper left, soft elongated shadows and refined highlights. Warm ivory #f4f1e8 seamless tabletop and backdrop with no room or horizon. Forest green #153e39 leather and cloth, subtle brushed brass accents, cream paper, transparent emerald glass when specified. No ornate luxury or gold overload.

Everything essential sharp, soft unobtrusive backdrop. Not an abstract icon, not a toy.
Text: absolutely NO words, digits, letters, labels, logos, watermarks or signatures. UI and papers contain only graph geometry and faint table rules. No UI border around the whole image. No people or hands, no random plants, no coins, money, huge arrows, lightbulbs or stock decorative spheres. Render1600x1200 or equivalent4:3.
Subject: a thick opened ivory financial report booklet on a thin dark forest-green cloth portfolio, viewed with a noticeably different composition from the reference: book spread extends left-to-right, with a brass-and-dark-green magnifier resting on the RIGHT lower page and its handle pointing diagonally outward to the right. The left page shows a clean ascending and descending fine green line chart and a structured four-column blank numeric-style table WITHOUT any actual numbers or text. The right page shows two restrained graphical comparison charts only. A slim brass page clip at the top left and one compact dark green document tab. Lens physically magnifies the page underneath, accurately grounded and believable. The story is careful analysis and finding where financial issues begin, no treasure-hunt aesthetic.
assets.reviewNotes: New independent image; meaningful process subject and consistent ivory/emerald/brass palette. Realistic object construction and clear composition.
